paper_title: Paper Copilot A Self-Evolving and Efficient LLM System for Personalized   Academic Assistance
caption: Efficient deployment methods dramatically reduce the time cost. The average total time cost before efficient deployment is 87.1s (26.2s + 60.9s), which is reduced by 69.92% after efficient deployment.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates a comparison of time costs, presenting two categories: "Efficient deployment" and "Reduction." The chart consists of two slices, arranged in descending order by size. The "Reduction" slice is colored orange and occupies approximately 69.92% of the chart, with a numeric label of 60.9s. The "Efficient deployment" slice is blue, representing roughly 30.08% of the chart, and has a corresponding numeric label of 26.2s. Both slices include percentage labels displayed within them, and the chart lacks a separate legend.
